reviews.text: I highly recommend Costello’s ProServices! Al did an amazing job cutting down the overwhelming amount of weeds that had taken over the front of my yard.
reviews.author: Kayla Y.

reviews.text: Our Church, First Zion Baptist Church of Edgemont, obtained several estimates to address a chimney concern. The chimney needed masonry work and a chimney cover to keep critters out.
reviews.author: sonya W.

reviews.text: They came to the house and did a free estimate! The men were professional and friendly. I had a tenant who left a mess in my rented apartment and they came and cleared out the mess this person left in my home. They removed everything!!
reviews.author: Rebecca B.
